title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Ace coding interviews and write fast production code. Master Big-O complexity, Hash Maps, Two Pointers, Stacks & Queues, Binary Search, Trees/BFS, and Dynamic Programming.
prerequisites: Comfort with loops, functions, and arrays in any language
outcomes: Analyze time and space complexity using Big-O notation
Turn O(n^2) nested loops into O(n) solutions using Hash Maps and Two Pointers
Model LIFO and FIFO workflows cleanly with Stacks and Queues
Search sorted spaces in O(log n) with Binary Search
Traverse trees and graphs with BFS/DFS and optimize overlapping subproblems with DP
